brand_lines.note: A UK coffee shop lists the Bonavita Variable Temp Digital Electric Kettle, 1L ("this full-featured electric kettle from Bonavita"). Bonavita's own site didn't load.
Victorinox's UK site has a Chef's Knives category: Fibrox, Swiss Modern and Grand Maitre chef's knives.
Wüsthof's official online store has a Chef's Knives collection (Gourmet 8" Chef's Knife among them). Writers spell it Wusthof.
Tojiro's own (Japanese) site lists the TOJIRO PRO series with gyuto (牛刀, the Japanese chef's knife) from 180 to 300 mm.
Misono Cutlery's own site lists a gyutou knife (牛刀) in its UX10 series, made in Seki, Japan.
Lodge's own (US) site has a Skillets collection of cast iron skillets (Classic round skillet and others).
Field Company's own (US) site sells cast iron skillets (No.8 and No.10 Skillet, the Chef Skillet). Writers call it Field.
Lodge's own (US) site has a Dutch Ovens collection, with enamelled Dutch ovens (4.5 and 6 quart) among them.
Le Creuset's UK store has a Casseroles category of cast iron casseroles: the UK name for a Dutch oven.
Zwilling's UK site (Staub's owner) lists "Cast iron STAUB Cocottes & Dutch Ovens", La Cocotte from 20 to 28 cm.
Cosori's own (US) store has an Air Fryers collection of ten models (TurboBlaze, Dual Blaze, Pro LE and others).
SharkNinja's UK site (Ninja's maker) has an Air Fryers category under Cooking Appliances.
SharkNinja's UK site has a Blenders category under Blenders & Food Prep (hand blenders are a category of their own).
SharkNinja's UK site has a Toasters category under Kitchenware.
Zojirushi America's own site has a Rice Cookers category. Whether UK shoppers can buy them is the price list's job.
Tiger Corporation's own site (its US pages) has a Rice Cookers section.
Aroma Housewares' own (US) site has Rice & Grain Cookers and Digital Rice & Grain Multicookers.
Vitamix UK's store sells blenders (Ascent and Explorian series), containers and spares.
nutribullet's UK store sells personal, portable and family blenders (the 600 Series, the Blender Combo 1200W).
KitchenAid's UK site sells stand mixers, medium and large (the Artisan tilt-head mixer among them).
KitchenAid's UK site has a Food processors category under Small Kitchen Appliances.
Kenwood's UK site sells stand mixers: Chef, Chef XL, Titanium Chef Patissier XL, kMix and others.
Bosch's UK site lists its MUM kitchen machines as stand mixers (Series 2, 4 and 6).

Comandante's own site: it "develops and manufactures high performance coffee grinders" (C40, C60, X25). From price: Clumsy Goat's Comandante range on 12 Oct 2026, the C40 MK4 at £219 (the cheapest; sold out that day) and the C60 Baracuda at £479; no X25 listed.
1Zpresso's own store sells manual coffee grinders (K-Ultra, J-Ultra, X, Q and ZP6 series). Several older models aren't sold in the UK any more (price list).
Baratza's UK site sells coffee grinders (Encore ESP, Virtuoso+, Sette 270) in pounds.
De'Longhi's UK site has a Manual Espresso Machines category under Coffee machines, besides its automatic machines.
The UK medicines register's product page for Nizoral 2% shampoo (ketoconazole), made by Thornton & Ross. The brand's own UK site didn't load.
Head & Shoulders' UK site sells dandruff shampoos, dandruff conditioners, 2 in 1s and scalp balms.
Innersense Organic Beauty's UK pages have a Shampoo collection (the Hairbaths, such as Pure Harmony Hairbath).
HASK's own site sells shampoos (Repair + Argan Oil, Smooth + Keratin & Jojoba Oil and others).
Batiste's European site (its region selector includes the UK; batistehair.co.uk redirects there) lists dry shampoos in every range.
Batiste's whole range (All Products) is dry shampoos and leave-in dry conditioners: no shampoo to wash hair with. Writers who praise Batiste in a shampoo thread mean its dry shampoo.
L'Oréal Paris UK's Hair Serum page lists Extraordinary Oil Sublime Hair Enhancer and Extraordinary Oil Midnight Serum. Noemi's own example, 12 Oct 2026.
O'Keeffe's own (US) site has a Lips range: Lip Repair lip balms.
Burt's Bees UK sells lip balms (Beeswax, Honey and Pomegranate Lip Balm).
